welcome.title: Welcome to Seraph
welcome.body: Your strap's data, your way. Reads directly from your strap via Bluetooth. No subscription, no account, no cloud.

rings.title: Your Rings
rings.subtitle: Three numbers, updated every time your strap syncs.
rings.strainDesc: How much cardiovascular load you've accumulated today. Builds up with any activity that raises your heart rate.
rings.recoveryDesc: How ready your body is for effort today, based on your overnight HRV, resting heart rate, and sleep.
rings.sleepDesc: How much of your sleep goal you hit last night. Tap to see your full sleep breakdown.

tour.title: Finding Your Way
tour.subtitle: A quick look at how the app is laid out.
tour.dateNav: Today's date. Tap the arrows or the date itself to jump to any past day.
tour.device: Your strap's connection status and last sync time. Tap to manage your device.
tour.rings: Your rings for the selected day. Tap any ring to go deeper.
tour.activitiesDesc: Workouts and sleep sessions appear here as your strap detects them, or when you log them manually.
tour.swipeHint: Swipe left or right anywhere on the overview to move between days.

connect.title: Connect Your Strap
connect.body: Go to the device tab after this and connect your strap. Your first sync will pull up to 14 days of history.
connect.tip: Keep Bluetooth on and the app running in the background so it can sync automatically.

profile.title: About You
profile.subtitle: Optional — helps calibrate your recovery and sleep calculations.
profile.name: NAME
profile.fthrHint: The heart rate where you tip from aerobic into hard effort. If you've done a 20-minute all-out test, use that number.

sensitivity.title: Activity Detection
sensitivity.subtitle: Which activities should the app pick up automatically?
sensitivity.hint: You can change this anytime in Settings.
sensitivity.everythingDesc: Almost any movement counts, including a short walk
sensitivity.lightDesc: A short easy walk or a few minutes of light movement and above
sensitivity.moderateDesc: A light jog or 30 or more minutes of easy movement and above
sensitivity.workoutsOnlyDesc: A solid 30-minute run or similar. Short walks and easy movement won't count.
sensitivity.offDesc: No activities are detected automatically. You can still log workouts manually.

storage.title: Storage
storage.subtitle: Control how the app stores your data.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Head to the device tab and connect your strap to get started.
done.tip: Keep Bluetooth on and the app running in the background so it can sync automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name

settings.sensitivityEverythingDesc: Almost any movement counts, including a short walk.
settings.sensitivityLightDesc: A short easy walk or a few minutes of light movement and above.

storage.granularityHint: More frequent means more storage used, with little practical difference for most people.
storage.estimateNote: Based on ~9.3 MB/day measured at highest resolution.

trends.helper_recovery: Your daily recovery score over time. Look for patterns around training blocks, travel, or poor sleep.
trends.helper_hrv: The variation in time between heartbeats. A higher value relative to your baseline means your body has recovered well.
trends.helper_rhr: Your resting heart rate over time. A lower resting HR usually means your cardiovascular system is adapting well to training. Spikes can indicate illness or accumulated fatigue.
trends.helper_strain: Your daily strain score over time. Useful for spotting whether you're consistently under or overloading your body.
trends.helper_sleep: How long you slept each night. The shaded band shows your sleep goal.
trends.helper_sleepAwake: Minutes spent awake during each sleep session. Lower is better — occasional short awakenings are normal.
trends.helper_steps: An overview of your step counts over time.
trends.helper_activeTime: Minutes of elevated heart rate activity per day. Any movement that meaningfully raises your heart rate counts.
trends.helper_dailyStress: A day-long view of your HRV. Lower values indicate more physiological stress.
trends.strainVsRhrDesc: How yesterday's strain affected today's resting heart rate.
